declarations.label: MRP
declarations.requirement: Retail sale price declared as maximum retail price, inclusive of all taxes.
declarations.format_hint: Declared price should read as a currency mark followed by an amount.
declarations.pass_note: Maximum retail price is legible on the principal display panel.
declarations.missing_note: No retail sale price was detected on the supplied image.
declarations.review_note: Printed price is visible, but the currency mark is partially obscured.

declarations.label: Net quantity
declarations.requirement: Net quantity in standard units of weight, measure or number.
declarations.format_hint: Net quantity must carry a numeric value and a standard unit.
declarations.pass_note: Unit and quantity are readable on the front panel.
declarations.missing_note: No net quantity declaration was detected.
declarations.review_note: A quantity was read but the unit is uncertain in this frame.

declarations.label: Manufacturer / packer
declarations.requirement: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer.
declarations.format_hint: Name and address block must be present.
declarations.pass_note: Name and address block detected on the rear panel.
declarations.missing_note: No manufacturer, packer or importer name was detected.
declarations.review_note: A name was read but the address block could not be confirmed.

declarations.label: Packing date
declarations.requirement: Month and year in which the commodity was pre-packed, manufactured or imported.
declarations.format_hint: Packing date must give month and year as MM/YYYY.
declarations.pass_note: Month and year of packing are legible.
declarations.missing_note: No legible packing or manufacture date was detected. Capture the seal and batch area to confirm.
declarations.review_note: A date was read but the month and year could not be separated reliably.

declarations.label: Consumer-care details
declarations.requirement: Name, address, telephone number and email of the person to be contacted for consumer complaints.
declarations.format_hint: A contact route for complaints must be present.
declarations.pass_note: Consumer-care contact detected near the lower seal.
declarations.missing_note: No consumer-care contact route was detected.
declarations.review_note: A contact was read but some digits are uncertain in this frame.
